subject: 辽金北方王府院落模块（原创扩展；非具名王府或宫殿复原，细部待考）
prompt: Edit the supplied Dali royal residence sprite into a NEW Liao-Jin northern princely-residence map module for tianshu/default, id bld_kit_liao_jin_north_wangfu. Preserve the input realistic Song-baseline rendering, camera, fine restrained detail density, single courtyard layout and true transparent RGBA background, but change regional features to northern Yanjing/Datong 10th–12th centuries. Original unnamed game princely compound, not a claim to reconstruct a named Liao or Jin palace. Main broad timber audience hall at rear with a sober gray-tiled early-medieval hip-and-gable roof and substantial compact bracket sets, muted red-brown columns, simple lower side halls, plastered buff-earth perimeter walls on low stone footing, south gate front facing screen lower left. Court mostly compacted earth with modest central stone paths, no lush southern flowering plants. No imperial yellow glazed roof, no dense gilding, no Qing palace decoration, no towering terraces. Footprint20m east-west by16m north-south;5:4 axis-length ratio. The ground contact plane must be precisely2:1 dimetric, camera yaw45 elevation30: east projected slope+0.5 and north projected slope-0.5, parallel edges parallel, verticals vertical. Three visible floor corners left/front/right must be sharp and clear on a paper-thin base without a diorama plinth. Natural light upper-left and short soft lower-right contact shadow. Entire isolated asset inside generous transparent margins. No people, animals, writing, signs, plaques, flags, symbols, watermark, modern objects, outside road, landscape, gradient, halo or checkerboard.
negative: 人物、文字、徽记、现代物、明清旅游风、厚地台、裁切、景观背景、伪透明棋盘格、非等比拉伸

references.role: image_gen首候选输入；既有宋候选时代适配参考，不表示新图获作者批准

created_time_basis: 源PNG文件mtime；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: paste without mask into transparent RGBA padding; alpha retained; no repaint/warp

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面外边端点，±3px；隐藏后角由平行四边形假设推算。未过阈值不表示通过。
